meaning: Real connection occupancy crossed an explicitly configured capacity waterline and was detected deterministically; a real model report completed but did not adequately explain that risk. Both discovery and recovery are verified, not complete diagnosis or production benefit.

timing.control_timing_meaning: ON and OFF request acceptance times; actual connection release is independently bounded by the post-OFF samples and direct cleanup observation.

collection.source: Actual selected Zabbix histories through a read-only API

whole_on_window.scope: Harness measurements for the whole ON window; distinct from the model frozen subwindow.

deterministic_result.active_summary: 用量34/40，占用85%，剩余6；已超过配置的80%关注水位。具体原因待分析。

model_report.headline: 数据库连接利用率85%，连接数由9升至34

recovery.meaning: Connection occupancy returned to observed pre-switch values; not proof of overall database health.

post_run_verification.scope: Separate read-only rule-state query and read-only visitor HTTP request after the harness ended; not part of the raw harness record.

harness_acceptance.explanation: The report froze 18.06 seconds after ON, below the original 20-second report-window gate. This is separate from the real three synchronized 5-second capacity samples and independent recovery observations.

analysis_limitations: The AI report correctly states 34/40 and 85%, but omits that the explicitly configured 80% waterline was exceeded and weakens the risk to continued observation.
The real model input already included the active capacity risk, configured 80% waterline, remaining 6, and three synchronized sample pairs; this was not an input omission.
Some compound conclusion/action statements mention utilization or the limit without also citing the capacity-denominator evidence.
No connection leak, exact SQL, downtime, or complete root cause was established.
Availability uses sparse-on-change history; an older successful observation is not immediate proof that all service behavior is normal.
Zabbix trigger events were not reviewed in this run; no claim is made that Zabbix could not alert.

public_demo_label.meaning: 发现与恢复已验证 · 分析待完善

evidence_integrity.hash_scope_note: The raw record covers the harness measurements; later rule/HTTP readbacks and the actual model audit have separate hashes and must not be attributed to the raw record hash.
